# langsmith_platform_features (Data Source)

Reads the consolidated LangSmith **platform features** view (`GET /v1/platform/features`): default model and disabled models per feature key. Use this data source to discover valid `feature` values and current settings before managing a `langsmith_platform_feature` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) Bogware, Inc. 2025
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "langsmith_platform_features" "example" {}

output "feature_keys" {
  value = [for f in data.langsmith_platform_features.example.features : f.feature]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `features` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))

<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Read-Only:

- `default_model` (String) Configured default model for this feature, if any.
- `disabled_models` (List of String) Models disabled for this feature (sorted in state for stable plans).
- `feature` (String) Feature key (matches the `{feature}` path segment on `/v1/platform/features/{feature}/...`).
